ja: 『スター・ウォーズ』より、「マンダロリアン」と共に旅をする人気キャラクター「グローグー」を1/4スケールでプラモデル化！
■全高約100mm。「通常顔」に加え3種の表情パーツ、垂れた耳パーツも付属し、差し替えで表情豊かなグローグーを表現できる。
■付属のホバリングプラム（1/12スケール）は、カバーの開閉をパーツの差し替えで再現。クリア台座も付属し、浮遊感を演出できる。
■ホバリングプラムに搭乗できる1/12スケールのグローグーも同梱。別売りの「1/12 ザ・マンダロリアン（ベスカーアーマー）」と並べることで劇中イメージの再現が可能。
en: From "Star Wars ", the popular character " Grogoo " who travels with " The Mandalorian" is made into a 1/4 scale plastic model!

• Overall height approximately 100mm. In addition to the "normal face", 3 types of expression parts and drooping ear parts are also included, allowing you to express a richly expressive Glow Goo by replacing them.
• The included hovering plum (1/12 Scale) reproduces the opening and closing of the cover by replacing parts. A clear pedestal is also included to create a floating feeling.

• Also included is a 1/12 Scale Groogoo that can be used to board the Hovering Plum. By arranging it with "1/12 The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor)" (sold separately), you can recreate the image from the movie.
